# Interest rate curve (`ir-curve` v1)

Discounting (OIS), projection (IBOR/term RFR), government or basis curve for a currency.

**Group:** Market data · **Mnemonic:** `CRV` · **Identifiers:** `CRV-…` in `curveId`

Open one with `CRV <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: ir-curve
version: 1
description: "Discounting (OIS), projection (IBOR/term RFR), government or basis curve for a currency."
match: { kind: ir-curve, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Market data · Interest rate curve, id: $.curveId }
strip:
  - { label: Currency, bind: $.currency }
  - { label: Type, bind: $.curveType }
  - { label: Index, bind: $.index }
  - { label: "10Y", bind: $.tenY, fmt: pct4, emphasis: true }
  - { label: "2s10s", bind: $.slope2s10s, fmt: bp1, tone: sign }
  - { label: Points, bind: size($.points) }
  - { label: As of, bind: $.asOf, fmt: date }
panels:
  - id: curve
    kind: line
    title: Zero rates (%)
    code: CRV
    key: F2
    rows: $.points
    x: tenor
    y: zeroRate
    fmt: price2
  - id: points
    kind: table
    title: Pillars
    key: F3
    rows: $.points
    columns:
      - { label: Tenor, bind: "@.tenor" }
      - { label: Instrument, bind: "@.instrument" }
      - { label: Quote, bind: "@.quote", fmt: pct4 }
      - { label: Zero, bind: "@.zeroRate", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: DF, bind: "@.df", fmt: df4 }
  - id: forwards
    kind: line
    title: "1Y forward rates (%)"
    area: right
    rows: $.forwards
    x: tenor
    y: rate
    fmt: price2
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.calendar, 'calendar')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
